title: Final Judgment
definition: Final judgment is God's future judgment of all people through Jesus Christ according to truth, righteousness, and justice.
summary: Every person will give account to God. The judgment will reveal God's justice and the truth of every life.
christFocus: The Father has appointed Christ as Judge, and salvation is found only in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Every person will give account to God. The judgment will reveal God's justice and the truth of every life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
